industries.name: Real Estate
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Real Estate Businesses
industries.summary: Real Estate marketing: Budget and location mismatch in enquiries? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: A high enquiry count can hide buyers outside your location, price range or property type. We align listings, advertising and follow-up with the inventory you actually sell. Real estate SEO and paid advertising should match property location, buyer budget and listing availability. Landing pages and viewing forms help separate suitable buyers from enquiries your team cannot serve.
problems: Budget and location mismatch in enquiries
Property campaigns leading to generic pages
Slow follow-up after forms and brochure downloads
industries.approach: Create project or listing pages with location, property type, price context where approved, availability and a specific viewing or enquiry action. Qualification questions should help your team respond with the right property.
industries.measure: Qualified property enquiries, booked viewings and progression to serious sales conversations.
industries.inputs: Project details, service areas, approved property assets and your definition of a qualified buyer.

industries.name: Hospitality
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Hospitality Businesses
industries.summary: Hospitality marketing: Website visits that do not reach the booking engine? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Guests compare location, experience, availability and value before booking. An attractive website still needs a clear offer and a reliable route to reserve or enquire. Hospitality SEO and hotel advertising connect room information, guest needs and booking availability. A clear direct-booking or stay-enquiry path supports the decision after discovery.
problems: Website visits that do not reach the booking engine
Campaigns that overlook seasonality and guest intent
Local profiles with incomplete booking information
industries.approach: Match pages and campaigns to the stay, dining or event being considered. Show approved amenities, location details and booking conditions, then reduce friction between your website and reservation system.
industries.measure: Direct booking progression, reservation enquiries and attributable booking value where integration allows.
industries.inputs: Property or venue details, booking platform information, target guest segments and seasonal priorities.

industries.name: Healthcare
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Healthcare Businesses
industries.summary: Healthcare marketing: Service pages that do not explain appointment suitability? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Patients need trustworthy information about services, locations and appointments. Marketing should make access easier while keeping claims accurate and protecting personal information. Healthcare SEO and appointment-focused landing pages should explain the actual services, location and contact process. We use verified provider information and avoid unsupported treatment or outcome claims.
problems: Service pages that do not explain appointment suitability
Weak local visibility for genuine clinic locations
Forms requesting unnecessary sensitive information
industries.approach: Build accurate service and location pages using provider-approved information. Keep appointment forms simple and avoid collecting medical details in advertising or analytics events. Content approval and platform eligibility are checked before campaigns.
industries.measure: Relevant appointment enquiries, booking journey completion and local contact actions.
industries.inputs: Approved services, provider credentials, clinic locations and appointment platform details.

industries.name: Travel & Tourism
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Travel & Tourism Businesses
industries.summary: Travel & Tourism marketing: Destination traffic with little package interest? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: A destination attracts curiosity as well as buyers. Your pages need to answer dates, inclusions, suitability and booking questions so qualified travellers can move forward. Travel agency SEO and paid campaigns should match destination, departure dates and traveller needs. Trip enquiry forms collect the details your team needs to recommend a suitable option.
problems: Destination traffic with little package interest
Unclear inclusions, availability or booking conditions
Enquiries that stall while travellers compare options
industries.approach: Connect destination guides to actual tours and packages. Commercial pages should explain the experience, inclusions, schedule, suitability and enquiry process with approved terms.
industries.measure: Qualified package enquiries, booking progression and campaign contribution to bookings.
industries.inputs: Current packages, operating destinations, approved itinerary details and booking conditions.

industries.name: SaaS & Technology
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for SaaS & Technology Businesses
industries.summary: SaaS & Technology marketing: Paid campaigns generating poor-fit demos? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: A signup only matters when the user fits your product and reaches value. We align use-case pages, paid acquisition and measurement with the buyers and accounts you can serve. SaaS marketing connects product search intent with use-case content, demo requests and trial journeys. B2B lead generation considers the buyer role and the product problem being evaluated.
problems: Paid campaigns generating poor-fit demos
Feature pages without clear use cases
Disconnected trial, customer management system and campaign reporting
industries.approach: Create distinct pages for core use cases and buyer roles. Match your trial or demo action to purchase complexity and connect acquisition data to qualification where your systems allow.
industries.measure: Qualified demos, activated trials and opportunity creation rather than signup volume alone.
industries.inputs: Product positioning, target accounts, key use cases and current trial or sales journey.

industries.name: Ecommerce
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Ecommerce Businesses
industries.summary: Ecommerce marketing: Product visits that do not reach checkout? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Paid traffic cannot repair a confusing product page or unreliable checkout. We review acquisition, merchandising journeys and measurement together before scaling spend. Ecommerce SEO and paid advertising should connect product discovery with clear categories, product information and checkout. Conversion tracking is reviewed against the purchase actions your platform can confirm.
problems: Product visits that do not reach checkout
Duplicate or missing purchase tracking
Campaign reporting disconnected from store revenue
industries.approach: Prioritise product information, delivery and return clarity, mobile purchasing and event accuracy. Tests should reflect your available traffic and margins rather than chase a generic conversion target.
industries.measure: Purchase conversion rate, customer acquisition cost and contribution after advertising where data is available.
industries.inputs: Store access, catalogue priorities, purchase event setup and commercial margin context.

industries.name: Professional Services
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Professional Service Businesses
industries.summary: SEO, paid advertising and website improvements for professional services. Focus on suitable enquiries and clear buying information.
industries.body: Buyers need to understand fit, expertise and work included before making an enquiry. Broad service lists rarely answer the specific problem that brought them to your website. Professional services SEO and B2B lead generation explain expertise, scope and customer fit. Service pages answer evaluation questions before inviting a business enquiry.
problems: Generic service pages with unclear work you receive
Enquiries outside the firm’s expertise or budget
Useful content without a route to a commercial service
industries.approach: Build service pages around the problems you solve, the clients you suit and the process of engagement. Connect supporting articles to a relevant work included request and make qualification practical.
industries.measure: Suitable enquiries, sales-accepted opportunities and pipeline progression.
industries.inputs: Service work included, ideal client profile, approved expertise evidence and common sales objections.

industries.name: Home Services
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Home Services Businesses
industries.summary: Home Services marketing: Calls from outside the service area? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Local demand is highly specific. Location, urgency and service type must line up with your ads, profile and pages so your team receives jobs it can actually take. Home services marketing connects local SEO and Google Ads with real service coverage. Quote forms should establish the job, location and scheduling requirements before follow-up.
problems: Calls from outside the service area
Paid clicks for services you do not provide
Weak connection between local pages and enquiry actions
industries.approach: Organise pages around real services and coverage. Make contact actions easy on mobile, use accurate availability information and review enquiry quality by location and job type.
industries.measure: Qualified job enquiries, relevant calls and booked jobs where the sales process is tracked.
industries.inputs: Service list, genuine coverage areas, operating hours and enquiry handling process.

industries.name: Education & Training
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Education & Training Businesses
industries.summary: Education & Training marketing: Course traffic without suitable applications? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Prospective learners compare entry requirements, format, costs and outcomes. Clear course pages help them assess suitability before applying. Education marketing connects course search intent with accurate admissions information. Enquiry pages explain eligibility, study format and the next step using details supplied by your institution.
problems: Course traffic without suitable applications
Confusing entry requirements or study formats
Enquiries that stall before enrolment
industries.approach: Build accurate course and programme pages with approved requirements, study format and application steps. Separate student and institutional journeys when their buying decisions differ.
industries.measure: Qualified course enquiries, application progression and enrolment contribution where tracked.
industries.inputs: Approved programme information, target learner groups and the application journey.

industries.name: Recruitment & Staffing
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Recruitment & Staffing Businesses
industries.summary: Recruitment & Staffing marketing: Employer campaigns attracting candidate enquiries? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Employer buyers and job seekers have different needs. Campaigns and website journeys must distinguish hiring services from job applications. Recruitment marketing separates employer enquiries from candidate applications. SEO pages and paid campaigns need clear audience targeting and different forms for each customer journey.
problems: Employer campaigns attracting candidate enquiries
Specialist recruitment services buried in broad pages
Unclear information passed to your team of hiring enquiries
industries.approach: Create employer service pages around roles, sectors and engagement models. Keep candidate applications on their own path and qualify employer enquiries by hiring need.
industries.measure: Qualified employer enquiries, sales opportunities and time to the first useful response.
industries.inputs: Target employers, placement specialisms, service models and customer management system workflow.

industries.name: Logistics & Supply Chain
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Logistics & Supply Chain Businesses
industries.summary: Logistics & Supply Chain marketing: Quote requests outside supported routes? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: A logistics enquiry needs to fit your geography, cargo requirements and service capacity. Broad traffic can create work without viable opportunities. Logistics SEO and B2B advertising explain routes, service coverage and shipment requirements. Quote enquiries collect the information your team needs to assess a suitable job.
problems: Quote requests outside supported routes
Service pages missing capability and shipment context
Manual routing of inbound commercial enquiries
industries.approach: Organise commercial pages by actual logistics capabilities and coverage. Quote forms should collect enough business context to route the request without creating excessive friction.
industries.measure: Suitable quote requests, opportunity progression and routing efficiency.
industries.inputs: Supported routes, service capabilities, commercial criteria and sales information passed to your team process.

industries.name: Solar & Energy Services
industries.headline: Digital Marketing for Solar & Energy Services Businesses
industries.summary: Solar & Energy Services marketing: Enquiries outside installation coverage? Explore SEO, paid ads and website improvements built around your customers.
industries.body: Interested customers may fall outside your service area or installation criteria. Clear offers and practical qualification help your team spend time on suitable enquiries. Solar marketing connects local search and paid campaigns with property suitability and installation enquiries. Pages use your verified service coverage and explain the assessment process without unsupported savings claims.
problems: Enquiries outside installation coverage
Campaign promises that do not match the actual offer
Forms missing essential project suitability information
industries.approach: Explain approved installation services, coverage and the assessment process. Use relevant qualification fields and avoid unsupported claims about savings, grants or eligibility.
industries.measure: Suitable assessment enquiries, booked consultations and quote progression.
industries.inputs: Coverage areas, installation criteria, approved claims and enquiry assessment process.
